text:
Marathon Petroleum rose 1.45% today as oil prices held firm and U.S. refineries operated at 97.4% capacity—near maximum levels. The stock gained ground as crude stayed around $84 per barrel domestically, with tighter refinery utilization supporting margins for a major processor. This move extends the stock's 3.77% climb over two weeks.

The broader tailwind here is geopolitical: escalating U.S. economic pressure on Iran, including a naval blockade of its oil exports announced this week, tightens global oil supply and keeps prices elevated. Higher crude prices and high refinery utilization both support Marathon's profitability, which is why refiners have been lifted amid Middle East tension over the past month.
